notes: Budgeted delivery E1 saved-facts probe (plan C4 step 1): memory-qa's existing facts lane as it is, LoCoMo dev, main reader, with the facts token count recorded. Legacy adapter, its own ingest and extraction, unbounded context.

cells.lease_basis: plan estimate $1.80 extraction and $1 QA, x2 headroom
cells.command: bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark locomo --split dev --system gbrain --facts conversation --qa reader --qa-context facts --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/facts"
cells.setup_command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets locomo,beam-100k,lme-s && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}
